app.name: PrepProfit
app.tagline: Financial management for chefs and food businesses

welcome.subject: Welcome to PrepProfit, {org}
welcome.body: Your organization {org} is ready. Add your ingredients and recipes to start costing, then explore financials, invoices and inventory. Reply to this email if you need a hand.

lowStock.subject: {count, plural, one {# ingredient is running low} other {# ingredients are running low}}
lowStock.body: These ingredients in {org} are at or below their low-stock threshold and may need reordering:

actionErrors.INVALID_INPUT: Please check the values and try again.
actionErrors.NOT_FOUND: That item could not be found. It may have been removed.
actionErrors.DUPLICATE_NAME: A folder with that name already exists.
actionErrors.ALREADY_IN_RECIPE: That ingredient is already in this recipe.
actionErrors.INGREDIENT_IN_USE: This ingredient is used by an active recipe, so it can't be moved to the trash. Remove it from those recipes first.
actionErrors.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: That stock-out is larger than the quantity on hand. Recount the stock or enter a smaller amount.
actionErrors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This stock change conflicts with one already recorded. Refresh and try again.
actionErrors.RECIPE_HAS_TRASHED_INGREDIENTS: This recipe uses ingredients that are also in the trash. Restore those ingredients first.
actionErrors.INGREDIENT_IN_TRASHED_RECIPE: This ingredient is still part of a trashed recipe. Delete that recipe permanently first.
actionErrors.CATEGORY_IN_USE: This category is used by one or more transactions, so it can't be deleted. Reassign or remove those transactions first.
actionErrors.INVOICE_LOCKED: This invoice has already been issued, so it can no longer be edited or deleted. Void it instead.
actionErrors.INVOICE_NO_CUSTOMER: Add a customer before issuing this invoice.
actionErrors.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: That status change isn't allowed for this invoice.
actionErrors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that. Financial data is available to managers only.
actionErrors.RATE_LIMITED: You're doing that too quickly. Please wait a moment and try again.
actionErrors.EMAIL_FAILED: The email couldn't be sent. Please check the address and try again.
actionErrors.UPGRADE_REQUIRED: This feature isn't included in your current plan. Upgrade to unlock it.
actionErrors.PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: You've reached your plan's limit. Upgrade to add more.
actionErrors.IMPORT_EXPIRED: This import preview has expired. Upload the file again to import it.
actionErrors.AI_EXTRACTION_FAILED: We couldn't read a recipe from that photo. Try a clearer, well-lit image.
actionErrors.USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED: You've used all of this month's photo extractions on your plan. They reset next month, or upgrade for more.
actionErrors.UNEXPECTED: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again.

regional.title: Currency & units

privacy.title: Data & privacy
privacy.description: Export your organization's data or request its deletion.

export.title: Export your data
export.help: Download a complete JSON copy of your organization's data — recipes, ingredients, financials, invoices, payroll, imports and activity log.

delete.title: Delete this organization
delete.help: Request permanent deletion of your organization and all its data. This records the request — our team processes it and confirms by email. It does not delete anything immediately.

noAccess.title: Managers only
noAccess.body: Workspace settings — currency and measurement system — can only be changed by a manager. Ask an organization manager if you need a change.

import.title: Import
import.subtitle: Bring ingredients, transactions or recipes in from a CSV or Excel file. Nothing is created until you review the preview and confirm.

setup.title: Set up your business

marketing.headline: Stop guessing. Know what every dish really costs.
marketing.subhead: PrepProfit replaces your spreadsheets with a financial dashboard built for kitchens.

features.title: Everything a food business needs to run on the numbers
features.subtitle: From the cost of a single dish to the month's profit — in one place, multi-tenant and secure.

costing.title: Recipe costing
costing.body: Ingredient cost, yield and loss, hidden costs and live margin on every recipe. Change a price, see the impact instantly.

financials.title: Financials & break-even
financials.body: Track income and expenses, see dashboards and P&L, and simulate break-even scenarios before you commit.

operations.title: Invoices, payroll & inventory
operations.body: Gap-free invoicing, employee shifts and period summaries, and an authoritative stock ledger with low-stock alerts.

ai.title: Imports & AI photo extraction
ai.body: Import ingredients, transactions and recipes from CSV/Excel, or photograph a recipe and review an AI-drafted card.

ctaBand.title: Ready to cook with confidence?
ctaBand.subtitle: Start free. No spreadsheet surgery required.

marketing.footerNote: Multi-tenant, role-based and secure by design.

selectOrg.title: Choose or create an organization
